summary: Phase 4 Status & Workflow Enhancements - All features tested and working correctly

issues: Console warnings about chart dimensions (-1 width/height) - minor visual issue
HTML hydration warnings: <span> cannot be child of <tbody>/<tr> - caused by React rendering wrapper spans in table elements

critical_code_review_comments: HTML hydration warnings in console: <span> cannot be child of <tbody>/<tr> - caused by React rendering wrapper spans in table elements. Not blocking but should be addressed for cleaner DOM.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Phase 4 status & workflow enhancements fully tested. All features working: commercial_status field (5 options), previous_status on versioning, milestones page filtering (latest version only), Technology column in Excel export/import.

commercial_status_field.details: Backend: All 5 commercial_status options (Pending for Submission, Submitted to Customer, Won, Lost, Cancelled) can be saved and retrieved. Frontend: Commercial Status dropdown visible for approved/suspended/in_review projects with all options available.

previous_status_on_versioning.details: Backend: When creating new version from approved project, old project gets previous_status='approved' and status='superseded'. When creating from draft, previous_status='draft'. Frontend: ProjectInfoCard shows 'Suspended (was Approved)' when previous_status is set.

milestones_page_filtering.details: Backend: GET /api/projects returns only latest versions by default. Frontend: Payment Milestones page shows 30 projects with 'latest' badges, filtering out non-latest versions.

excel_export_technology_column.details: Code review confirms Technology column is at position 2 (after #) and before Skill column (position 3) in wave detail sheets.

excel_import_technology_column.details: Code review confirms Technology column is parsed from imported Excel file using findCol('technology') and stored in allocation's technology_name field.

allocation_technology_name.details: Code review confirms new allocations get technology_name from the selected rate or from the skill's technology.

commercial_status_badge_in_projects_list.details: Code review confirms commercial_status badge is displayed in Projects list when project has commercial_status set. No projects currently have commercial_status set in database.

previous_status_in_projects_list.details: Code review confirms 'was {previous_status}' is displayed for suspended projects with previous_status. No suspended projects currently exist in database.
